summary: Tarsus Pharmaceuticals closed its acquisition of Alkeus Pharmaceuticals on September 4, 2026 under the July 31, 2026 merger agreement, with Alkeus surviving as a wholly owned Tarsus subsidiary. Tarsus paid $270 million cash and issued 2,908,692 shares as up-front consideration, plus up to $350 million milestones ($250 million regulatory, $100 million first-sale) and low-to-mid single-digit gildeuretinol revenue sharing. The filing does not state a premium, advisor, or board recommendation. Key overhang is the stock portion and future milestone dilution; watch gildeuretinol FDA timing and deal-related selling.
